_: Characters drawn in Ash's style (public/art/packs/test). Each is made by editing Ash's own base drawing, so pose, proportions and pixel style carry over, with a cut-out of the character from public/art/ref/chars/ (not in the repo) as the reference. See scripts/art/gen-char.mjs.
same: Keep exactly the same side-on pose facing right, the same body proportions, height and pixel art style: standing upright, arms hanging relaxed at the sides, empty hands, no weapon, no backpack, transparent background.
